name: ariadne
description: Agent-driven single-crystal diffraction reduction from Bruker/Rigaku frames to evidence-linked INS/HKL and solve-single-crystal handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-lattice hypotheses, joint pixel fitting and structure handoff.
interface.longDescription: Open-source-first single-crystal reduction with nonexclusive reciprocal/detector compatibility, unique-anchor joint DIALS refinement, scan-block holdouts, NNLS/Poisson overlap fitting and identifiability-aware composite observations. Includes immutable hypotheses, event records, asynchronous scientific MCP tools and INS/HKL handoff to solve-single-crystal. Experimental and untested; global composite absorption/scaling remains incomplete.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ariadne-reduction to process my Bruker or Rigaku diffraction data, inspect scientific evidence before accepting each stage, and continue through solve-single-crystal when INS/HKL handoff is ready.
